BL-1229 — BL-757 widened landPilotedTicket's deps contract and ten hand-built test stubs were never updated, so 22 assertions crash instead of asserting
What it solves: - "[2026-08-28] specifier: the architect's note said 9 tests; measured, it
  is 10 files and 22 assertions. Counted by running each file individually
  under `node --test` and grepping for the TypeError, because Vitest cannot
  collect these files at all (they import from `node:test`) and reports
 …
Approval context: One thing needs sign-off: how much to change. The minimum repair is to add the missing member to ten stubs, which fixes today's 22 crashes and leaves the next contract widening free to do exactly this again. This ticket takes the stronger line — make the connection between contract and stub exist, …
BL-1229 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1229" (or "reject BL-1229 <reason>") to act.
